planning.input: I have pasta, tomatoes, parmesan and cream.

proposal.description: A quick pasta dish using fresh tomatoes and cream for a light, creamy sauce, finished with parmesan for richness.

steps.headline: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring 2 l of salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add 200 g pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally. Reserve 120 ml of pasta cooking water, then drain the pasta and set aside.

steps.headline: Prepare tomatoes
steps.instruction: Cut 300 g tomatoes into small dice, removing any hard cores. Set aside.

steps.headline: Sauté tomatoes
steps.instruction: Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add a drizzle of olive oil and the diced tomatoes. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and slightly broken down.

steps.headline: Make the sauce
steps.instruction: Reduce heat to low. Stir in 120 ml cream and 40 g grated parmesan. Simmer gently for 3 minutes, stirring often, until the sauce thickens slightly. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

steps.headline: Combine pasta
steps.instruction: Add the cooked pasta to the sauce. Toss well to coat evenly. If needed, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce.

steps.headline: Finish and serve
steps.instruction: Remove from heat. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper if needed. Serve immediately, topped with extra grated parmesan if desired.

planning.input: I have pasta, tomatoes, parmesan, cream and a banana.

proposal.description: A simple, rich pasta dish using the tomatoes, cream and pasta you have, finished with parmesan for a savoury touch.

steps.headline: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add 200 g pasta and cook according to the package instructions until al dente. Reserve 100 ml pasta cooking water, then drain the pasta.

steps.headline: Prepare tomatoes
steps.instruction: Score an X on the bottom of each tomato. Blanch in boiling water for 30 seconds, then transfer to ice water. Peel, deseed and chop the tomatoes into small pieces.

steps.headline: Sauté tomatoes
steps.instruction: Heat 15 ml olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.

steps.headline: Add cream
steps.instruction: Pour 100 ml cream into the pan with the tomatoes. Simmer for 3 minutes, stirring often, until slightly thickened. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

steps.headline: Combine pasta
steps.instruction: Add the drained pasta to the tomato-cream mixture. Toss well to coat. If needed, add a splash of the reserved pasta cooking water to loosen the sauce.

steps.headline: Add parmesan
steps.instruction: Remove the pan from heat. Stir in 30 g grated parmesan until melted and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper if needed.

steps.headline: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Divide the creamy tomato pasta between two plates. Serve hot with extra parmesan if desired.

proposal.description: A quick, filling breakfast using eggs and bread with staples.

steps.headline: Heat the oil
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tsp neutral oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking.

steps.headline: Beat the eggs
steps.instruction: Crack 2 eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and a few grinds of black pepper, and beat until just combined.

steps.headline: Cook the eggs
steps.instruction: Pour the beaten eggs into the pan. Stir gently with a spatula, folding the eggs from the edges toward the center, until softly set but still slightly runny in the middle, about 2 minutes.

steps.headline: Toast the bread
steps.instruction: While the eggs cook, toast the bread until golden and crisp.

steps.headline: Plate the dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the scrambled eggs to the toasted bread. Serve immediately.

planning.input: I have pasta, tomatoes and parmesan. I can buy a couple things.

proposal.description: A quick pasta dish using fresh tomatoes and parmesan for a light, flavorful meal with minimal ingredients.

steps.headline: Cook the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add 200 g pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 125 ml pasta cooking water, then drain the pasta.

steps.headline: Prepare tomatoes
steps.instruction: Score the skin of the tomatoes with a small cross at the base. Blanch in boiling water for 10 seconds, then transfer to ice water to cool. Peel, deseed, and finely chop the tomatoes.

steps.headline: Sauté garlic
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add 1 clove garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.

steps.headline: Cook tomatoes
steps.instruction: Add the chopped tomatoes to the pan with the garlic. Simmer over medium-low heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes break down into a thick sauce. Season with salt to taste.

steps.headline: Combine pasta
steps.instruction: Add the drained pasta to the tomato sauce. Toss well to coat. If needed, add a splash of the reserved pasta cooking water to loosen the sauce.

steps.headline: Finish the dish
steps.instruction: Remove the pan from heat. Stir in 40 g grated parmesan. Tear 4 basil leaves and stir half into the pasta. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed.

steps.headline: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Divide the pasta between two plates. Garnish each portion with the remaining basil leaves. Serve warm.
